issues.title: Incorrect revenue calculation
issues.problem: Revenue should only include transactions with status 'COMPLETED', but the query includes all transactions where status is not 'FAILED'.
issues.fix: SUM(CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_REVENUE

issues.title: Missing filter for 'COMPLETED' status
issues.problem: The query should filter transactions where status is 'COMPLETED' to correctly calculate revenue.

issues.title: Inconsistent naming convention
issues.line: FACT_TRANSACTIONS, DIM_MERCHANT, MERCHANT_NAME, AMOUNT, TOTAL_REVENUE, TOTAL_TXNS
issues.problem: The query uses inconsistent naming conventions (e.g., FACT_TRANSACTIONS vs. m.MERCHANT_NAME). It should be consistent, either all uppercase or all lowercase.
issues.fix: SELECT m.merchant_name, SUM(t.amount) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_txns FROM fact_transactions t JOIN dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY m.merchant_name;

review.corrected_sql: SELECT m.merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_txns FROM fact_transactions t JOIN dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY m.merchant_name;
review.summary: The query had critical correctness issues with revenue calculation and missing filter for 'COMPLETED' status. It also had a readability issue with inconsistent naming conventions.
